data_fields.donor_constant: optional lower bound per requirement; inverted bounds raised to min

data_fields.name: requires_version_max
data_fields.donor_constant: default MAX when no max is given (code after the doc line; not line-numbered)

data_fields.name: scale_step_default
data_fields.donor_constant: 1 (step default in clear and in the parse default)

best_idea: Let a content pack override another by its position in a priority list, resolve a pack's requirements (with a version range) before it, and refuse a pack whose requirement is missing at any position, so an unmet dependency is never enabled silently.
decision_why: Priority-ordered event packs with version-ranged requires fit server-staged content; reject whole-file override for live rows (two packs replacing one file lose data silently) and keep balance numbers as published rows, not pack globals.
acceptance: A staff event pack that requires core 1.0 to 2.0 is refused at stage time, with the missing or out-of-range requirement named, when core is absent or listed after it (server test: resolvePacks returns an error for the event pack when core is missing, and an order core then event with no errors when core is present).
